correctness.rationale: Exact boundary ODE gives the hypergeometric Laplace transform and renewal mean. Green recursions give exact first three moments. Reconstructing the Taylor series yields c1,c2. Exact Fraction interval bounds prove a c1 root strictly inside (1019/1250,4077/5000), c1prime<-0.5074 throughout and c2>0 at this root by a 128-cell concavity-based lower bound on the third moment. Implicit function theorem gives a positive unique strict local minimum near lambda=0 for m just above m_c, with coefficient K. The bundled certificate.py ran successfully from its package path; numerical_check.py independently tests ODE and near-critical minimizers. No finite enumeration is substituted for the infinite-dimensional proof. Residual limits: diffusion only, local only.
